0.long_answer: The disorder described is anorexia nervosa. This eating disorder is characterized by an intense fear of being overweight, even though individuals are typically underweight. It is also marked by a preoccupation with body weight and shape, whereby sufferers often focus obsessively on perceived physical flaws. This persistent concern about weight gain and body image disturbance leads to behaviors such as severe caloric restriction, excessive exercise, and sometimes purging. The condition is serious and can have severe health consequences, including nutritional deficiencies and other medical complications.
